scope: Users can inspect and explicitly select current approved career-story revisions while preparing job-specific cover letters. The worker revalidates profile, job, story revision, allowed use, and linked-fact provenance; generated story text remains exact, local, and review-required; immutable document history resolves the referenced revision and shows its provenance.
